text:
Ravi: quick q — can the console give us a way to 'replay' fallback decisions? ops wants to reproduce why a request fell back for RCA.
Ava: yes, strong +1. playback would save so much time for postmortems. needs to show policy version, route inputs, and the decision trace.
Morgan: we had a small spike last quarter that captured an executable snapshot: request + route params + model_variant + kv_cache_head + batch_info + node_metrics. proof-of-concept looked like:
```
request:
  route: 'chat-prod'
  user_id: 'redacted'
  prompt_tokens: 152
  model: 'gptx-4'
fallback_event:
  reason: 'upstream_503'
  selected_variant: 'gptx-4-quant-v2'
  policy_version: '2026-03-02T13:12:00Z'
  node_latency_ms: 420
```
Sam: ops-bot just emitted a fallback event a min ago for that route, pasted below. we should be able to click -> "replay in sandbox" to see same decision without hitting prod models.
ops-bot: FALLBACK_TRIGGERED: route=chat-prod fallback_to=gptx-4-small policy=policy-73 reason=connection_timeout instance=prod-us-west-2
Ava: a few product constraints: 1) redaction by default (PII must be scrubbed), 2) opt-in role for 'replay' (security), 3) retention policy for recorded snapshots.
Morgan: agree. technical note: for deterministic replay we need to capture RNG seeds, kv cache state, and batching context. otherwise results differ and it's useless.
Ravi: UX idea — two modes: 'audit playback' (readonly, shows decision tree and inputs) vs 'simulate' (run through current policy + latest model variants).
Sam: also surface the telemetry at each step: latency, retries, error codes, throttles. filter by timeframe, policy id, route, and model variant.
Ava: add an audit trail item for every replay: who ran it, when, what snapshot id, outcome. compliance will want that.
Morgan: implementation note: store snapshots as small envelopes referencing encrypted off-cluster blobs, not inline in DB. snapshots get a signed id.
Ravi: what about scope — only replay customer requests or also synthetic traffic? ops wants both.
Ava: allow both but tag synthetic explicitly. require extra permission to replay customer requests.
Sam: action items: Morgan to prototype snapshot format + deterministic replay by next Wed, Ava to draft UX flows and permission matrix, Ravi to collect ops examples to seed dataset.
Morgan: will do. starting with a minimal schema and a retention TTL flag.
Ava: thanks — I'll schedule a 30m sync after prototype. :thumbsup:
